title: Exactly Fifteen Seconds of Music
tests: Checks whether the agent delivers one continuous, exactly 15-second music file despite the per-clip generation limit, rather than substituting a shorter clip or separate parts.

faults.what: The supplied transcription reports audible speech, "ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳು.", violating the explicit no-vocals requirement.

judge.summary: A single 15-second audio file is supplied, but reported spoken words violate the no-vocals requirement.

must_haves.item: One playable audio file is delivered, not multiple separate music segments.
must_haves.why: The supplied sound report identifies one audio file, ambient_bed.wav.

must_haves.item: The decoded audio duration is 15.00 seconds, within 0.05 second.
must_haves.why: The supplied audio report gives a duration of 15 seconds.

must_haves.item: Music fills the duration rather than padding a shorter track with a long silence.
must_haves.why: The duration and peak level do not establish whether music fills the entire file.

must_haves.item: No singing or spoken words are audible.
must_haves.why: The supplied transcription explicitly reports speech: "ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳು."

must_haves.item: Any internal joins are musically smooth, without clicks, gaps or jarring changes in tempo or sound.
must_haves.why: The supplied report provides no information about internal joins or their audible smoothness.
